combat_scope: Unconditional wearer ATK percentage joining the live base-ATK-scaled ATK sum. Additive damage-bonus-zone ratio against Broken enemies only. On a Broken-enemy defeat, heal the wearer for the frozen fraction of live Max HP, settled with live healing modifiers, capped at missing HP, unable to revive, rounded once to nearest integer. One per-wearer 30s world-time cooldown starts on each qualifying defeat; simultaneous defeats share it and separate wearers are independent.

independent_oracles: T5 end-to-end zone oracle (0 DEF/0 RES, static 1000, base 1000): ATK = 1000 + 1000*1/5 = 1200; Broken-tagged zone modifiers atk_percent 1/5 + damage bonus 1/5, so the Broken hit is 1200*(1+1/5) = 1440; untagged 1200; no proc 1000. The 1440 engine round-trip is not reachable (see known_gaps). (whale_t5_broken_hit_end_to_end)

Quantization (COMBAT_FORMULA_CONTRACT sections 5/6): Max HP 99 / HP 50, T1 -> gross = round(99*3/10) = round(29.7) = 30 (nearest, ties upward), applied 30 -> HP 80, overflow 0. (whale_heal_rounds_fractional_gross_once)
known_gaps: Global release availability is unverified in the frozen catalog.
No native break gauge exists in the runtime, so Broken defeats only occur when a scenario declares the content-owned Broken status tag; native break-triggered defeats are unmodeled.
The kill-heal callback settles at ProcCallback priority via a queued content event; exact native callback ordering relative to other same-time events is a modeled choice.
Strict scenarios must pre-accept weapons.whale_v1; the hypothesis is recorded on the wearer's defeat callback, not on cast (no cast hook is wired for this weapon).

GameScenarioRequest has no field to declare target Broken status at start, so the 1440 Broken-hit oracle is pinned through exact zone modifiers on a Broken-tagged state rather than an engine round-trip; a scenario-level Broken-status declaration for targets is the return condition.

passive_effect.localized:
Increases ATK by {0}.
Increases the wearer's damage to Broken enemies by {1}. Restores {2} HP to the wearer if a Broken enemy is defeated. Triggers at most once every {3}s.

攻击力提高{0}。
装备者对处于倾陷状态的敌人造成的伤害提高{1}，如果敌人在倾陷状态下被击杀，则回复装备者{2}生命值，该效果{3}秒内最多触发1次。

tested_hypotheses: Broken state is detected through the content-owned ntesim.status.broken target status tag; the tag name is not asserted to be the native GameplayTag because the frozen tables expose no break-gauge binding and the runtime simulates no break gauge.
The {0} ATK percentage is unconditional and joins the live base-ATK-scaled ATK sum (base_atk * p added to ATK), never multiplying compiled static ATK.
The {1} Broken damage ratio joins the single additive damage-bonus zone (M_bonus) only while the target carries an active Broken tag; it is not a final, special, or multiplicative factor.

The {2} heal amount is a ratio of live Max HP (30% of effective_hp_max captured at defeat), settled with live healing modifiers, rounded once to nearest integer, capped at missing HP, and cannot revive a defeated wearer.
The 30s cooldown is reserved on each qualifying Broken defeat, including defeats while the wearer is already defeated; a dead wearer's queued callback settles with applied 0 and no revival.
Simultaneous Broken defeats share one wearer cooldown; the exact 30s boundary is ready again; separate wearers keep independent cooldowns.
Trigger credit is the wearer's own delivered fatal hit; teammate defeats do not trigger the wearer's heal.
Frozen package evidence does not establish Global release availability.
